quest.title: The Wind Has Ceased
quest.description: There's an abandoned sanatorium on Windrest Peak...

dialogues.text: Some people just won't listen. I already told you, now's not the time to go up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Easy there, Old Mann. Let's calm down and talk this out.
We were getting along just fine earlier at the Night Brew, too.
But the moment I mentioned I was heading for Windrest Peak, he grabbed me and dragged me all the way here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Huffman. What's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: As you can see, Old Mann is trying his best to keep people away from Windrest Peak.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Anyway, let me introduce you. This is Lipphart, an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: What I saw... What I felt... It was terrifying! Surely you don't wish to hear it?

dialogues.speaker: Lipphart
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like I'm going anywhere today, so let's hear it. Consider it an extension of our drinking and bragging session from earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Lipphart
dialogues.text: So, what sort of "great peril" are we facing here?

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: The sanatorium's haunted! Seriously! I saw them ghosts with my own eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ghosts!?

dialogues.speaker: Mann
dialogues.text: It happened last night...
